t: The Smart Wrench can be used to easily remove tech blocks and also select blocks for special functionality. $(br2)Use as a normal wrench: $(5)Sneak right click$() to pick up and $(5)right click$() to rotate.$(br2)$(5)Right click$() in the air to change mode
智能扳手可用于轻松拆除科技方块，也可用于为特殊功能选择方块。$(br2)作为普通扳手使用：$(5)潜行右键$()可拾取，$(5)右键$()可旋转。$(br2)$(5)对空气$()右键可切换模式。
If the wrench is in $(thing)Select Mode$(), then it can be used to perform specialized operations on (for example) blocks like the Shield Projector.
如果扳手处于$(thing)选择模式$()，那么它可用于对某些方块执行专门操作，例如护盾投射仪。
